welcome.heading: Welcome to AITrader2
welcome.subtitle: A few steps to get your paper-trading research workspace ready. Not financial advice.

profile.heading: Your profile
profile.description: Risk level and markets shape which strategies and stocks you are offered.

universe.heading: Load the universe
universe.description: Downloads S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and TA-125 constituents plus their price history. This can take several minutes — leave the tab open.

analysis.heading: Run the first analysis
analysis.alreadyComputed: Scores already computed — the leaderboard is ready.
analysis.description: Scores a first batch of stocks (technical indicators + news sentiment) so recommendations have something to rank. The nightly pipeline covers the rest of the universe.

recommendations.heading: First recommendations
recommendations.description: Generate an initial portfolio proposal: BUY recommendations sized to your capital, drawn from today's top-ranked stocks.

done.heading: All set 🎉
done.description: Your workspace is ready. The nightly pipeline keeps prices, scores and recommendations fresh; visit the Strategy Lab to compare strategies, or Settings to link Telegram notifications.

skip: Skip setup — I'll explore on my own
